correctness.rationale: Exact logarithmic differentiation of all three published environment ODEs yields Hdot=σ with cancellation of both behavioral frequencies. Exponentiating gives the two rigorous face-union estimates, with the min/product power argument. Compactness constrains all omega-limit points; invariant-measure exclusion follows from impossibility of a finite nonzero translation-invariant probability distribution on the real line. Sharpness is demonstrated by an explicit source-admissible interior equilibrium and an equilibrium interval at harmonic resonance. Symbolic identities, exact rational source ODE checks and numerical trajectories were reproduced; no unproved global convergence to a single equilibrium is asserted.

value.rationale: The full five-variable model is used for network-game oscillation and multistability but its detailed global dynamics are poorly controlled by the original equilibrium table. A quantitative, payoff-independent environmental face-selection law applies to every positive trajectory and yields an exact resonance separating inevitable environmental boundary approach from possible entirely interior equilibrium families. It resolves whether numerically observed apparent oscillations for the paper’s parameter sets can be true interior cycles; their drift 7/8 and 55/728 excludes that interpretation but permits boundary dynamics.
